public.text: The distinction between system conformance and architecture conformance is valuable. However, “conformance of the architecture” combines several different assessments: model validity, alignment with the reference architecture, coverage, traceability, and documentation of deviations.
public.suggestedRevision: Separate these into clearly defined assessment dimensions: model validity, reference alignment, capability coverage, relationship completeness, traceability, and documented deviation. Define the expected evidence and assessment method for each.
